bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant for Professional Golfers' Association of America championship events.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; PROFESSIONAL GOLFERS' ASSOCIATION (PGA) OF AMERICA CHAMPIONSHIP EVENTS. +]

[+$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to the city of Chaska to attract, and for costs associated with hosting, a package of future PGA of America championship-level events, which shall include at least one men's PGA championship and one women's PGA championship. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, ..... +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant for Professional Golfers' Association of America championship events.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PROFESSIONAL GOLFERS' ASSOCIATION (PGA) OF AMERICA CHAMPIONSHIP EVENTS.

$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to the city of Chaska to attract, and for costs associated with hosting, a package of future PGA of America championship-level events, which shall include at least one men's PGA championship and one women's PGA championship. This appropriation is onetime and is available until June 30, .....
